why: No major reviewer or authority (RTINGS, Wirecutter, CPSC, a furnace maker's support page) is in the results. Every source is a niche calculator site, affiliate guide, brand blog (UDPOWER, OUPES) or generic AI-style listicle, and the five that answer it do so with spec math and runtime tables, none with a tested blower start or a priced hookup kit. This matches the pattern of our proven win: several niche pages with numbers, nothing authoritative, and a gap on the "how do I connect it" half of the question.
